propositions: Three user-level Copilot skills (rebar-implement, rebar-janitor, rebar-debug) silently fail to register because their SKILL.md frontmatters violate the Agent Skills spec: two exceed the 1024-character description cap and one contains an unquoted colon that breaks YAML parsing.
Copilot CLI drops non-conforming skills without error or warning, leaving no audit trail of failure.
SKILL.md frontmatters must be rewritten using YAML folded block scalars (description: >-) and descriptions trimmed to <= 1024 characters while preserving skill invocation triggers.

A new deterministic CI lint (scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py) must validate all tracked SKILL.md files: frontmatter must parse as YAML, description must be present and non-empty and <= 1024 chars, and name (if present) must be <= 64 chars and match ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.
The lint must be wired into make lint and backed by unit tests covering happy path and failure cases (over-cap, empty description, unparseable YAML, invalid name).
After fix, copilot skill list --json must discover all four skills and the repository checker must report PASS for valid frontmatter.
